resources.string: The game stopped unexpectedly. The end of its log:\n
To play, choose your own copy of Monster Hunter Freedom Unite: the European release (ULES01213, v1.01), dumped from your UMD as an .iso file.
Starting…\n\nThe first start copies the game\'s data from your ISO (about 750 MB), which takes a minute or two.
Can\'t open your ISO any more (moved or deleted?). Choose it again.
